_comment: Semantic SEO ground-truth. Values under `liveObserved` were captured from https://www.buckleupdriving.ca on 2026-06-03 and are what the live-baseline snapshot is checked against (regression guard on the golden master itself). Values under `businessFacts` are the canonical NAP/schema facts the WP build MUST reproduce verbatim (per PLAN.md §4). `intendedDivergences` are the three places the WP build is REQUIRED to differ from live — these are PASS conditions, not failures, and surface in the Parity Matrix as EXPECTED.

home.title: Best Driving School Vancouver | BuckleUp Driving School

intendedDivergences._note: Three deliberate SEO fixes in the WP build. The semantic-diff script ASSERTS these hold on the WP build and reports them as EXPECTED in the matrix — a WP page that matched the live BUG would be the failure.

self-canonicals.description: Every WP page emits its OWN absolute canonical. Live BUG: /locations/* and /blog/* inherit the homepage canonical (https://www.buckleupdriving.ca); /about & /services self-canonical but on the APEX host.
self-canonicals.wpExpected: self-referential canonical equal to the page's own www URL, e.g. https://www.buckleupdriving.ca/locations/coquitlam

www-standardization.description: All WP URLs (canonical, OG, sitemap, JSON-LD url/logo/image) use the www host and apex 301-redirects to www.
www-standardization.wpExpected: https://www.buckleupdriving.ca everywhere; apex returns 301 to www

complete-sitemap.description: WP sitemap lists ALL public URLs + CPTs + posts.
